fact: The national AI strategy (December 2025) states there is a legislative vacuum with no specific laws on data protection or AI, exposing citizens to fraud, deepfakes and algorithmic discrimination, and proposes a national AI authority, starting with a temporary committee under the Council of Ministers, and a data protection law by 2026.
title: الاستراتيجية الوطنية للذكاء الاصطناعي في دولة ليبيا 2025-2030
